title: City Council Regular Meeting
motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to approve the ordinance amending the Snow Canyon Commercial Planned Development zone to add “grocery store” to the approved use list and review concept plans for a proposed grocery store on approximately 4.75 acres generally located on the southwest corner of Snow Canyon Parkway and 2000 North known as Snow Canyon Commercial Center with the following conditions: 1. Low impact lighting to be used – specifically 20 foot light posts with lumen output being addressed; 2. Improve the exterior I on the south and east sides of the building to reflect that of the north and west sides 3. Roof treatment screens be implemented using earth tones on equipment as much as possible to have less visual impact 4. Proposed signage should be amended to 14.5 feet 5. Applicant should do as much as possible to reduce sound/noise created by delivery trucks
result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)
